step3.label: Step 3 of 9
step3.headline: Stop substituting memes for real conversations.
step3.subhead: The people in your life deserve more than a forwarded meme.
step3.body: Presence gives your phone a conscience — one that won't let you hide behind the feed.

step4how.label: Step 4 of 9
step4how.title: Here's how it works.
step4how.subtitle: Three steps. Real connection. Every day.
step4how.step1Desc: Your chosen apps lock automatically at your set time.
step4how.step2Desc: Send a genuine message to one of your trusted contacts.
step4how.step3Desc: Capture the conversation — both the message and the date must be clearly visible.
step4how.hint: Tip: make sure the screenshot is well-lit and easy to read.

step4.label: Step 5 of 9
step4.title: When should Presence protect you?
step4.subtitle: Your apps lock at this time every day. You unlock them by reaching out to someone real.

step6contacts.label: Step 6 of 9
step6contacts.title: Who keeps you grounded?
step6contacts.subtitle: Add the people you commit to reaching out to. They are your way out.
step6contacts.hint: Each time your apps are blocked, you'll need to message one of these people to unlock them.
step6contacts.ocrNote: When you upload a screenshot, we'll verify that one of these names appears in the conversation.
step6contacts.changeLater: You can add or remove contacts at any time from your profile.
step6contacts.empty: Add at least one person to continue.

step5.label: Step 7 of 9
step5.title: Which apps distract you most?
step5.subtitle: Select the ones Presence will shield.
step5.selectHint: Select at least one to continue.

step6.label: Step 8 of 9
step6.title: A few permissions needed.
step6.subtitle: Presence only uses these to run the shield.
step6.screenTimeDesc: Lets Presence know when you open a blocked app — without this, the shield cannot work.
step6.notificationsDesc: Receive gentle nudges before your block time starts.
step6.activityTrackingDesc: Helps Presence stay active in the background on Android.
step6.photoLibraryDesc: Required to upload your proof of genuine connection.
step6.requiredErrorBody: Screen Time and Photo Library are essential for Presence to work. Please enable both to continue.
step6.notificationsWarningBody: Without notifications, we can't remind you when your block time is near. You can enable this later in Settings.
step6.androidUsageBody: On the next screen, find 'Presence' in the list and enable it.
step6.androidBatteryBody: On the next screen, tap 'Don't optimize' so Presence can run in the background.
step6.requiredLockBody: To change it, go to your device Settings. Presence cannot work without it.
step6.photoDeniedBody: Presence needs photo access to verify your connection screenshots. Turn it on in Settings.

step7.label: Step 9 of 9
step7.title: Your real life is waiting.
step7.social: The cost of staying stuck is higher than any subscription.
step7.benefit1: Your apps lock. Your focus returns.
step7.benefit3: Streaks and insights that keep you honest.
step7.benefit4: The only app that demands real connection.
